name: Percent uncertainty
description: Dimensionless uncertainty metric computed by dividing absolute uncertainty by the measured value and scaling by 100.

name: Weight force
description: Force due to gravity acting on a mass in a local gravitational field.

name: Normal force
description: Surface reaction force acting perpendicular to the contact interface.

name: Tension force
description: Axial pulling force transmitted through a rope, cable, or string under tension.

name: Incline angle
description: Surface tilt angle measured from horizontal, used for force-component decomposition on inclines.
sign_convention: Measured from +x horizontal toward the incline surface.
author: austin

data.markdown: Surface tilt angle measured from horizontal, used for force-component decomposition on inclines.

name: Net force
description: Vector sum of all external and internal forces acting on the chosen object or system. It is the effective force that sets translational acceleration through Newton's second law.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector sum of all external and internal forces acting on the chosen object or system. It is the effective force that sets translational acceleration through Newton's second law.

name: Acceleration
description: Time rate of change of velocity, including both magnitude and direction changes. It quantifies how quickly motion state evolves in a chosen frame.
sign_convention: Positive along the chosen coordinate axis.
author: austin

data.markdown: Time rate of change of velocity, including both magnitude and direction changes. It quantifies how quickly motion state evolves in a chosen frame.
Positive along the chosen coordinate axis.

name: Mass
description: Measure of inertia that sets resistance to acceleration under applied force. In introductory mechanics it is treated as an intrinsic, approximately constant scalar property.
author: austin

data.markdown: Measure of inertia that sets resistance to acceleration under applied force. In introductory mechanics it is treated as an intrinsic, approximately constant scalar property.

name: Net Work
description: Algebraic sum of work contributions from all forces over a displacement. It equals the system's kinetic-energy change under the work-energy theorem.
author: austin

data.markdown: Algebraic sum of work contributions from all forces over a displacement. It equals the system's kinetic-energy change under the work-energy theorem.

name: Change in kinetic energy
description: Difference between final and initial kinetic energy for the same system over an interval. Positive values indicate net kinetic-energy gain, negative values indicate loss.
author: austin

data.markdown: Difference between final and initial kinetic energy for the same system over an interval. Positive values indicate net kinetic-energy gain, negative values indicate loss.

name: Momentum
description: Vector quantity equal to mass times velocity for a body. It captures how difficult the body's motion is to change in interactions and collisions.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector quantity equal to mass times velocity for a body. It captures how difficult the body's motion is to change in interactions and collisions.

name: System momentum sum
description: Vector sum of momenta of all components in a defined system.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector sum of momenta of all components in a defined system.

name: Time
description: Elapsed duration used to parameterize change in dynamical quantities. It defines the interval across which rates and accumulations are evaluated.
author: austin

data.markdown: Elapsed duration used to parameterize change in dynamical quantities. It defines the interval across which rates and accumulations are evaluated.

name: Initial velocity
description: Velocity value at the initial instant of the modeled interval. It serves as the baseline state for kinematic update equations.
author: austin

data.markdown: Velocity value at the initial instant of the modeled interval. It serves as the baseline state for kinematic update equations.

name: Velocity
description: Vector rate of change of position with respect to time. Its sign and direction encode how position evolves in the coordinate system.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector rate of change of position with respect to time. Its sign and direction encode how position evolves in the coordinate system.

name: Gravitational acceleration
description: Local magnitude of gravitational field acceleration near a massive body. Near Earth's surface it is commonly approximated as constant in introductory problems.
author: austin

data.markdown: Local magnitude of gravitational field acceleration near a massive body. Near Earth's surface it is commonly approximated as constant in introductory problems.

name: Height
description: Vertical displacement measured from a defined reference level. The sign convention determines whether upward or downward displacements are positive.
sign_convention: Positive upward from the reference level unless otherwise stated.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vertical displacement measured from a defined reference level. The sign convention determines whether upward or downward displacements are positive.

name: Potential energy
description: Energy associated with system configuration, such as position in a conservative field. Differences in this quantity track the capacity to do work via configuration changes.
author: austin

data.markdown: Energy associated with system configuration, such as position in a conservative field. Differences in this quantity track the capacity to do work via configuration changes.

name: Electric charge
description: Intrinsic property of matter that sources electromagnetic fields and experiences electromagnetic forces. Its sign sets interaction direction and its magnitude sets interaction strength.

common_aliases.context: Pair of interacting charges in Coulomb's law.

author: austin

data.markdown: Intrinsic property of matter that sources electromagnetic fields and experiences electromagnetic forces. Its sign sets interaction direction and its magnitude sets interaction strength.

rows: Pair of interacting charges in Coulomb's law.

name: Separation distance
description: Scalar separation between two source points or effective centers. In inverse-square laws it controls interaction strength through geometric dilution.
author: austin

data.markdown: Scalar separation between two source points or effective centers. In inverse-square laws it controls interaction strength through geometric dilution.

name: Coulomb constant
description: Proportionality constant in Coulomb's law for vacuum electrostatics. It sets the absolute force scale linking charge product and inverse-square separation.
author: austin

data.markdown: Proportionality constant in Coulomb's law for vacuum electrostatics. It sets the absolute force scale linking charge product and inverse-square separation.

name: Electric force
description: Vector force exerted on a charge by an electric field and other charges. Its direction follows field direction for positive charge and reverses for negative charge.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector force exerted on a charge by an electric field and other charges. Its direction follows field direction for positive charge and reverses for negative charge.

name: Electric field
description: Vector field defined as force per unit positive test charge at each point in space. It encodes both interaction direction and local interaction strength.
author: austin

data.markdown: Vector field defined as force per unit positive test charge at each point in space. It encodes both interaction direction and local interaction strength.

name: Voltage
description: Electric potential difference between two points in a circuit or field. It represents energy transfer per unit charge between those points.
sign_convention: Defined as potential at point A minus potential at point B.
author: austin

data.markdown: Electric potential difference between two points in a circuit or field. It represents energy transfer per unit charge between those points.
Defined as potential at point A minus potential at point B.

name: Electric current
description: Rate at which electric charge crosses a chosen surface or circuit cross-section. Conventional sign is defined by positive-charge flow direction.
sign_convention: Conventional current is positive in the direction of positive charge flow.
author: austin

data.markdown: Rate at which electric charge crosses a chosen surface or circuit cross-section. Conventional sign is defined by positive-charge flow direction.
Conventional current is positive in the direction of positive charge flow.

name: Resistance
description: Material or component property relating voltage drop to current in approximately linear (ohmic) operation. It quantifies opposition to charge flow under those conditions.
author: austin

data.markdown: Material or component property relating voltage drop to current in approximately linear (ohmic) operation. It quantifies opposition to charge flow under those conditions.

name: Magnetic flux

author: austin

data.markdown: Flux quantity equal to magnetic-field surface integral through an oriented area. It measures how much magnetic field passes through the chosen loop or surface.

data.markdown: Induced potential difference generated when magnetic flux through a loop changes over time. It is the driving quantity for induced current in closed circuits.
